title: Local DynamoDB is slow on /mnt/w (bb seed of 688 entries takes ~85s)
description: DynamoDB Local's data dir is .local/dynamodb/data on the Windows filesystem under WSL. Consider a data dir under ~ (or -inMemory option) for bb up, keeping bb reset semantics.

title: Session 0 readiness on prod: players join, then final checks
description: Prod is live with the GM and a seeded campaign, but on 2026-11-01 it had no players and no characters. Before the session: players join through an invite (confirms Cognito return to #/join/<code>), build characters, portrait and Debt show in the party, bb chronicle:roster prod <prod-campaign-id> (roster.json still holds the dev campaign), confirm portraits survive a redeploy, bb data:infra prod --min-capacity 0.5. After the session: --min-capacity 0. Point-in-time restore is on; no manual snapshot exists.
